task.title: No ROE SAT on the file and an application has been received

step.cmd: Create a Reminder (REM) WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select N on-complex .
Reason: Select Fact finding employer .
Comments: Type “follow-up, ROE SAT paper copy received, not in RCM”
Due date: Enter the date of the application + 26 days .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Details: Type “[name of the employer], [serial number of the ROE SAT].”

Destination: Enter the Service Canada centre as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Myself
Send to my pending workload: Check the box .
Reason: Select Fact finding employer.
Comments: Type “follow up - paper copy of ROE SAT received.”
Bring forward date: Modify to show 2 working days from today’s date.
Click Save.

If the employer was contacted, complete the following actions:
Inform the employer that the ROE SAT was not received and ask the employer to follow up with their payroll services provider.
Confirm the information on the paper copy of the ROE SAT.
Advise the employer that they will be contacted again in 2 working days for a follow up.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: New SROC: Main Issue: Select Other .
New SROC: Comments: Type “paper copy of ROE SAT received — [determine if the employer was contacted].”

Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Include the date the ROE SAT is expected to be transmitted. National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Click Save .

step.cmd: Determine if the employer was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the employer was not contacted, go to Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1 . Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1
If the employer was contacted, go to step 7.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the ROE SAT is in RCM:

ul.li: If no, go to step 8
If yes, go to step 15.

If the employer was contacted, complete the following actions:
Inform them that the ROE SAT was not received and ask if they were able to follow up with their payroll department or provider.
Ask when the ROE SAT is expected to be transmitted.
If the employer advises an agent that the ROE SAT was transmitted, but it cannot be found in RCM, refer the issue to a business expertise advisor and go to Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1 . refer the issue to a business expertise advisor Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “paper copy of ROE SAT received — [determine if the employer was contacted].”

Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Include the date the ROE SAT is expected to be transmitted. National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Click Save .

step.cmd: Determine if the employer was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the employer was not contacted, go to Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1 Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1
If the employer was contacted, go to step 11.

step.cmd: Determine if the employer provided an expected date for the ROE SAT:

ul.li: If no, go to Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1 . Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1
If yes, go to step 12.

step.cmd: Determine if waiting until the expected date will cause the REM WI to be overdue:

ul.li: If yes, go to Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1 . Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1
If no, go to step 13.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Fact finding employer .
Comments: Type “paper copy of ROE SAT”
Bring forward date: Enter the date the ROE SAT is expected to be on file.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in RCM determine if the ROE SAT is on file.

ul.li: If no, go to Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1 . Reassigning the Reminder (REM) WI to Level 1
If yes, go to step 15.
